stages.guide_requirement: Apnea-ECG acquisition: 35 learning + 35 official x records; ECG at 100 Hz; minute annotations; respiratory/SpO2 channels where available.
stages.implementation: The prepared workspace is the source for Stage02 records. Raw PhysioNet files are not redistributed in this repository.

stages.guide_requirement: ECG filtering/R-peak processing, 60-s non-overlap windows, HRV construction, available respiratory/SpO2 synchronization, normalization.
stages.implementation: Stage02 outputs are a declared prerequisite: data/processed/stage02_preprocessed/{record}_preprocessed.npz. The final Stage06 consumes ecg_filtered at 100 Hz with 60-s geometry.

stages.guide_requirement: Multimodal physiological feature engineering and ANOVA→mRMR→SHAP→PCA to a ~128-D representation.
stages.implementation: The frozen Stage03 rebuild produces 419 features and explicitly does NOT use AHI as an input because AHI would be derived from A/N reference annotations in this dataset. Stage04 bridge applies fold-safe ANOVA→mRMR→SHAP→PCA128.

stages.guide_requirement: Classical pre-encoder 128→64→32→8; 6–8 qubits; angle/amplitude/IQP alternatives; VQC, fidelity-kernel/QSVC, quantum-transformer; Pauli-Z measurement.
stages.implementation: Audited core uses 128→64→32→8, 8 qubits, Angle-Rx and dense all-pairs IQP, VQC depth 4 / 96 quantum parameters, fidelity-kernel SVM/QSVM, QT latent 64, Pauli-Z. Amplitude encoding is not established in the audited core and is not claimed.

stages.guide_requirement: PC/FCI/NOTEARS/LiNGAM, SCM/interventions/ACE, causal ranking, causal-aware fusion.
stages.implementation: Stage05 implements PC/FCI/NOTEARS/LiNGAM and a structural logistic outcome SCM; causal16 is selected by training-fold absolute ACE. The Stage06 causal-aware gate completes the fusion.

stages.guide_requirement: QML + CNN-BiLSTM + causal fusion; Task A Apnea/Normal; Task B OSA/CSA/Mixed; Task C A/B/C grouping.
stages.implementation: Task A is implemented. The final guide-native endpoint uses QML8 + temporal512 + gated causal16 → 536→256→128→64→2. OSA/CSA/Mixed is NOT trained because Apnea-ECG minute labels do not provide that target. A/B/C analyses are treated only as record burden categories, not apnea subtypes.

stages.guide_requirement: SHAP, quantum saliency/QFI/parameter-shift, causal DAG/intervention/counterfactual/mediation interpretations.
stages.implementation: Interpretability is represented in the evidence notebooks/manifests. Causal evidence is not promoted to clinical causality.

stages.guide_requirement: AdamW, regularization/scheduling, 35 learn + 35 test, 5-fold CV and LOSO, hybrid CPU/GPU tooling.
stages.implementation: Stage06 manifest locks AdamW, warmup+cosine, dropout, 50 epochs, 5-fold duplicate-safe CV and sealed x labels. LOSO is not established by the packaged core and is not claimed as completed here.

stages.guide_requirement: Performance, calibration/clinical, quantum, statistical and ablation evaluation.
stages.implementation: Packaged evidence covers final metrics/statistics and bounded robustness. No quantum-advantage claim is made; not every metric named on the guide image is asserted as completed by the core.
Repository contains the academic evidence package and reviewer-facing artifacts; journal acceptance/publication is not claimed.

explicit_nonclaims: AHI is not used as an input feature in the frozen Stage03 rebuild.
A/B/C record-category analysis is not an OSA/CSA/Mixed subtype classifier.
The repository does not claim a verified raw-data-to-Stage02 one-click build.
The 90.8627% promoted system is a project-level fixed-fusion extension, not the guide-native Stage06 checkpoint.
